title: Tapo (Rust/Python library) now speaks TP-Link's TPAP protocol
summary: Tapo is a Rust and Python library for controlling TP-Link Tapo smart home devices, now adding support for TP-Link's newer TPAP protocol alongside the existing KLAP protocol. This enables developers to programmatically control Tapo cameras, plugs, and bulbs through their own applications.
problem_solved: Enables programmatic control of TP-Link Tapo smart home devices using TP-Link's newer TPAP protocol, replacing proprietary workarounds.
why_valuable: Provides open-source, language-agnostic access to Tapo devices for home automation projects and custom integrations.
